response.name: Alpha 1.7.20 for 1.21.1 NeoForge
response.changelog:
This version attempts to fix Distant Horizons v3+ support (DH API 6+ support) as well as attempting to fix a rendering error.

[Villhume](https://github.com/Villhume) made his first contribution in PR [#306](https://github.com/Qendolin/better-clouds/pull/306)! Thanks so much!

response.name: Release 1.7.5 for 1.21 Fabric
response.changelog:
- Revamped dynamic tint calculations to integrate biome fog more intelligently.
- Night brightness now varies with the moon phase.
- Enhanced the fade-out effect for smoother visuals.
- Fixed compatibility issues with the "Fog" mod.
- Replaced the "Edge Fade" option with a more flexible "Fog Transition Factor."
- Overhauled cloud settings: vanilla quality options are ignored; "Height" can now be set to zero.
- Added support for YACL 3.6.
